# Gameable Engine

> Gameable Engine (`aos-gameable-engine`) is a browser game engine: gaussian-splat worlds rendered by three.js on WebGPU, with all game logic compiled to a WebAssembly component.

Status: M0-M3 shipped. Building a game? Read one task bundle below, copy a template, edit src/game.ts, run `npm run dev`, follow one recipe. Never read the whole repository; never edit packages/*.

## Bundles

- [llms-fps.txt](llms-fps.txt): first-person shooter.
- [llms-third-person.txt](llms-third-person.txt): third-person adventure.
- [llms-three-character.txt](llms-three-character.txt): a character in a three.js app.
- [llms-visit.txt](llms-visit.txt): a character page.
- [llms-multiplayer.txt](llms-multiplayer.txt): rooms.
- [llms-character.txt](llms-character.txt): splat characters.
- [llms-mystery.txt](llms-mystery.txt): the mystery kit (templates/mystery).
- [llms-survive.txt](llms-survive.txt): the survive kit.
- [llms-hangout.txt](llms-hangout.txt): the hangout kit.
- [llms-brawl.txt](llms-brawl.txt): the brawl kit.
- [llms-steal.txt](llms-steal.txt): the steal kit.
- [llms-collect.txt](llms-collect.txt): the collect kit.
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the core corpus, without the topics above.
